title: DNA Extraction Protocol for Nanopore Long-Reads Genome Sequencing
author: Cros-Arteil Sandrine
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bzbdp2i6
materials: Purification on Genomic-tip 100/G - Blood & Cell Culture DNA Midi Kit (25) 13343 QIAGEN according to Special Applications protocol 'Purification of genomic DNA prepared by other methods*' , followed by QIAGEN Genomic-tip procedure - Part II: Genomic-tip Protocol Protocol for Isolation of Genomic DNA from Blood, Cultured Cells, Tissue, Yeast, or Bacteria - QIAGEN Genomic DNA Handbook 08/2001, with at step 5 an over night precipitation of the total DNA in isopropanol at – 20 °C, followed day 4 by a centrifugation 20 min at 8000 rpm to finish by step 6B and resuspension of the total DNA in 100 µL DNase-free water or buffer according to the sequencing company. Note: At least 2/3 of DNA is lost throughout the final 100/G purification. At the end 8 µg of DNA must be obtained so the quantity of DNA extracted must be adapted to the prerequisite of the sequencing company.

steps.title: Grind mycelium to powder
steps.instruction: Using liquid nitrogen and a pre-chilled mortar and pestle, grind 0.2/0.3 g of fresh mycelium into powder in less than 1 minute.

substeps.instruction: Place the powder into a 15 mL Falcon tube.
Store in liquid nitrogen or at -80°C.

steps.title: Initial homogenization
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL TE 1X pH8 and 300 µL SDS 10% to the tube.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize without vortexing until the mixture is completely thawed.

steps.title: Proteinase K digestion
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of proteinase K at 20 mg/mL.

substeps.instruction: Homogenize by flicking the tube without vortexing.
Incubate at 37 °C overnight in a dry oven.

steps.title: Remove tissue debris
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 3 min at 4000 rpm.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the supernatant into a new 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Secondary SDS treatment
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL of SDS 10% and homogenize by slow inversion.

steps.title: NaCl precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1.3 mL NaCl 5 M and mix vigorously until white foam is obtained.

substeps.instruction: Incubate for 30 min on ice.
Mix again vigorously until white foam is obtained.

steps.title: Centrifuge and collect supernatant
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 25 min at 4000 rpm at 4 °C (with brake and acceleration on 4).

substeps.instruction: Carefully transfer the supernatant into a new 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Phenol-chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL of phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol (25:24:1).

substeps.instruction: Mix by inversion 200 times.
Centrifuge for 10 min at 5000 rpm at 4 °C.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase into a new 15 mL Falcon tube, avoiding the aqueous/organic interface (keep tubes on ice during transfer).

steps.title: RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Add RNase A to 2% of the final volume and incubate at 37 °C for 30 min in a heating unit or water bath.

steps.title: Second phenol-chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Repeat the phenol/chloroform/isoamyl alcohol extraction process (mixing 200 times, centrifuging 10 min at 5000 rpm at 4 °C, and transferring the aqueous phase).

steps.title: DNA precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 1/10 volume of NaAc 3 M pH 5.2 and 1 volume of isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Mix gently by inversion.
Place tubes at -20 °C for 3 h.

steps.title: Pellet recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 30 min at 8000 rpm at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Eliminate the supernatant by spilling the tube.
Briefly spin and eliminate residual supernatant by pipetting.

steps.title: Wash and dry DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Rinse the DNA pellet with 6 mL of ethanol 70% and centrifuge for 5 min at 8000 rpm at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Eliminate the supernatant by spilling and pipetting.
Repeat the rinse and centrifuge step twice.
Dry the DNA pellet at room temperature by opening the tube until no ethanol remains.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Carefully resuspend the DNA pellet in 500 µL DNase-free water.

substeps.instruction: Optional: Store DNA extracts at -20 °C, avoiding freeze-thaw cycles.

steps.title: Quality check
steps.instruction: Perform tests on DNA extract quality. If quality is insufficient, proceed to the polysaccharide removal steps (Steps 17-22).

steps.title: Polysaccharide removal: NaCl addition
steps.instruction: Add 500 µL of NaCl 2.4 M (to achieve 1.2 M final concentration).

steps.title: Polysaccharide removal: Diethyl ether wash
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL of diethyl ether saturated with DNase-free water (prepared by vortexing 1 vol diethyl ether and 1 vol DNase-free water, letting phases separate, and recovering the upper organic phase).

substeps.instruction: Mix by inversion 200 times.
Centrifuge for 20 min at 8000 rpm at 4 °C.
Transfer the lower aqueous phase into a new 15 mL Falcon tube.

steps.title: Polysaccharide removal: Ethanol precipitation
steps.instruction: Add 2.5 volumes of pure ethanol (pre-chilled at -80 °C) and place tubes at -20 °C overnight.

substeps.instruction: If the pellet appears during ethanol addition, it may be recovered with a cut cone and placed in a new 15 mL Falcon tube with 3 mL of ethanol 70%.

steps.title: Polysaccharide removal: Pellet recovery
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 35 min at 8000 rpm at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Eliminate the supernatant by spilling the tube.
Briefly spin and eliminate residual supernatant by pipetting.

steps.title: Polysaccharide removal: Final wash
steps.instruction: Rinse the DNA pellet with 5 mL of ethanol 70% and centrifuge for 20 min at 8000 rpm at 4 °C.

substeps.instruction: Eliminate the supernatant by spilling and pipetting.
Repeat the rinse and centrifuge step twice.
Dry the DNA pellet at room temperature by opening the tube until no ethanol remains.

steps.title: Final resuspension
steps.instruction: Carefully resuspend the DNA pellet in 100 µL of DNase-free water.

steps.title: Final quality check
steps.instruction: Perform tests on DNA extract quality.
